# GitHub Copilot Instructions for SoftServe Project

This project requires modern, accessible, and clean web development practices. When generating code, follow these rules:

## UI & Styling
- Always use semantic HTML5 tags (e.g., `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`).
- Ensure the design is modern, clean, and responsive (mobile-friendly).
- Keep styling consistent across all pages (Index and Team pages must match).
- If adding CSS, prefer modern techniques (Flexbox, CSS Grid) or use Tailwind CSS if it is included in the project.

## Functionality
- Ensure navigation links in the Navbar work correctly.
- Add toggle functionality for Light/Dark theme as per the project requirements.
- Write clean, commented JavaScript for interactive elements (like the theme toggle).

## Code Quality
- Add brief comments explaining complex sections of code.
- Avoid deprecated HTML tags or outdated CSS rules.
- Ensure the code is ready for pull request review.
